deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'python manage.py migrate --noinput && python manage.py shell -c "import os; from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model; u = get_user_model().objects.get(username=\"workshopadmin\"); u.set_password(os.environ[\"DJANGO_ADMIN_RESET_PASSWORD\"]); u.is_active = True; u.is_staff = True; u.is_superuser = True; u.save()" && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && exec waitress-serve --trusted-proxy=* --trusted-proxy-headers=x-forwarded-proto --listen=0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8000} uncle_kops_workshop.wsgi:application'
